gallery.caption: Four buttons, one picture. On turn 35 the brain chooses button 3 and earns a reward. The green trace shows simulated dopamine.
On turn 8 of the danger game, the brain hides. The white outline marks its choice and the numbers give the odds for each action.
Eat or wait? On turn 12 of the forage game, the brain waits. The panel shows its hunger alongside the cue it sees.
